resources.string: Changes \"sorry\" (and sry, soz, sowwy and every other spelling) to \"Dont say that your good man its ok\" in any app, right after you type it. It only reads the text box you are typing in, skips password boxes, and never sends anything anywhere.

To turn it on:

1. Tap the button below
2. Find "Sorry Fixer" in the list (it may be under "Downloaded services")
3. Switch it on and tap OK

Then type "sorry " anywhere and watch what happens.
Try it here: type sorry and a space
